title: Session postmortem
description: For a failed, cancelled or over-budget session: what happened, why, and what to change.

steps.name: reconstruct
steps.prompt: Use the control plane API at $API_URL (curl is fine; JSON responses). Useful routes: GET /projects, GET /projects/:id, GET /sessions, GET /sessions/:id/events, GET /graph/:id, GET /workflows, GET /workflows/:id, GET /brief?hours=N, GET /audit?limit=N, GET /chores, GET /ledgers?status=signed, GET /proposals, POST /workflows, POST /projects, POST /projects/:id/continue, POST /chores, POST /tasks/:id/go. You were given a session id. GET /sessions/:id/events and GET /graph/:id. Reconstruct the timeline: prompt, each tool call and its decision, parks and how they resolved, cost curve, the final outcome. Write POSTMORTEM.md: timeline, root cause in one paragraph, contributing factors, what the agent could not have known, and 3 concrete changes (prompt, grant template, skill, or workflow step) with the exact text.

steps.name: compare
steps.prompt: Using the similar sessions from the graph, compare this session with the two most similar successful ones: where did the paths diverge, and which change from POSTMORTEM.md would have prevented it? Append a Comparison section.

steps.name: review
steps.prompt: Review POSTMORTEM.md for blame-free wording and for whether the root cause is evidenced by the events. Report only.
